human_blocker: CONFENGE_INBOUND_WEBHOOK_SECRET unset in this environment; cannot sign a live canary. Public GET /health is READY with auto_send_enabled=false.
next_real_event: record attempted/reached on the first consented non-synthetic inbound lead_id after a real form POST

stages.label: URLs técnicas live/indexáveis
stages.next_action: do not invent live/indexable counts; land confenge.url_index.v1 when the search producer is ready
stages.observation: Indexability is not inferred from inbound volume or page views. Future ingest is confenge.url_index.v1.

stages.label: Impressões e cliques não branded
stages.next_action: do not invent GSC numbers; land confenge.search_observation.v1 when Search Console access exists
stages.observation: Non-branded impressions and clicks are not inferred from CTA or lead counts. Future ingest is confenge.search_observation.v1.

stages.label: CTA concluído
stages.freshness: public health READY; no real receipt observed from this environment
stages.next_action: wait for a real consented form POST; do not POST through a synthetic form
stages.observation: CTA completion is the signed form POST. It is not a lead, proposal, or cash. Same persist-first hop as the receipt; do not treat two stages as two conversions.

stages.label: Lead persistido
stages.next_action: no real receipt yet; do not invent a lead_id
stages.observation: A durable receipt is a lead. A page view, citation, or X-Ray completion is not. Synthetic/infrastructure_canary receipts stay off this default view.

stages.label: Conversa qualificada
stages.next_action: persist a real lead before recording a conversation
stages.observation: Qualified conversation requires a human-recorded reply/meeting/QCO. A callback or HTTP 200 is not a conversation.

stages.label: Proposta emitida
stages.next_action: do not emit a proposal without a qualified conversation
stages.observation: A proposal is a human-emitted commercial document. Pipeline open and checkout created are not a proposal.

stages.label: Receita recebida
stages.next_action: do not record receita without a proposal and a financial document
stages.observation: Callback, HTTP 200, checkout created, payment created, and page view are not receita. WON without a financial document is not caixa.

separate_metrics.label: Pipeline contratado
separate_metrics.observation: Contracted commitment is not caixa recebido.

separate_metrics.label: MRR
separate_metrics.observation: MRR is a recurring snapshot, not received cash.

separate_metrics.label: Cobrança criada
separate_metrics.observation: A created checkout or payment object is not receita recebida.

separate_metrics.label: Caixa recebido
separate_metrics.observation: Only reconciled received cents. Distinct from stage 7 until a document exists.
